`final class MsdfWriter`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.tool.msdf.atlas` · **Module:** `tool-msdf` · **Source:** [MsdfWriter.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/msdf/src/main/java/dev/joid/tool/msdf/atlas/MsdfWriter.java)

## Method details

<a id="MsdfWriter-method-write"></a>

### write

`void write(File file, List<GlyphEntry> glyphs, Kerning kerning, double[] metrics, String name, int weight, boolean italic, double size, double range, int[] pixels, int width, int height)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Writes the file with its signature, then the version, the weight, the italic flag, the name, the atlas size, the range, the glyph size, the metrics, every glyph, the kerning pairs and the pixels.
Throws an `IOException` when the file cannot be written.

## Constant and field details

<a id="MsdfWriter-constant-VERSION"></a>

### VERSION

`int VERSION` 

The version of the file format, part of the cache key of the atlases that JOID generates.
